title: Plasma Orb Astronaut
description: A glowing glass plasma globe sits on a wooden table, containing a distressed cartoon astronaut figure with wide eyes and open mouth. Bright neon electrical arcs in cyan, magenta, and yellow crackle around the astronaut while purple energy drips from the metallic base.
prompt: A highly detailed surreal painting of a large plasma globe on a wooden table in a dark room. Inside the transparent sphere, a cartoon astronaut in a spacesuit floats with a terrified expression, wide eyes and open mouth. Bright neon electrical arcs in cyan, pink, and yellow dance around the figure. Purple energy drips from the black metallic base onto the table. Dramatic lighting with glowing reflections, dark moody atmosphere.
